english.description: "Sweet! You got all the achievements! You're really somethin'. Isn't that right, Ryu?" "You have done well to reach the end of this one journey. The path to becoming a true fighter still lies ahead, but let us take time to share the joy of your accomplishment."
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_001

english.description: Why don't you try finishing up the tutorial? You might've mastered the first step, but nailing down the fundamentals is what's important.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_002

english.description: Your first goal for Story Mode is just to clear it once. You can probably guess, but I cleared it with Master Zangief first!
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_003

english.description: Whoa, I'm really mixing it with the celebrities here! C'mon, Rashid, you're the Raging Storm! Get out there and finish 5 Character Stories!
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_004

english.description: So you wish to learn Yoga? If that is truly the case, then first you must complete the Character Story with all characters. There is great merit in walking each of their individual paths.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_005

english.description: If you're at a loss for what to do, why not raise a character to level 5? It should help you realize what you're missing.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_006

english.description: Level up 5 characters! Up to level 5 should do the trick. When it comes to food and fightin', it's quantity over quality, mate.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_007

english.description: Your stats are as pitiful as your strength, maggot! Come back when you've raised all characters to level 5.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_008

english.description: Your objective should be to raise a single character to level 30. There is great meaning in accomplishing what is difficult. To find your answer, you must set your sights high.
english.displayName: Slow But Steady Wins The Race
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_009

english.description: Raise your player level to 50. Level up that much and you'll be about ready to exact you revenge.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_010

english.description: Your player level is a reflection of your passion! Aim for the stars, and reach level 100!
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_011

english.description: Niiihehe! 2, 20, 200! Such a glorious sound, I could say it twice more! 200! Raise you player level to 200! I already have, niiihehe!
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_012

english.description: Why don't you see if you can collect 10 titles? There's nothin' like a good title! Even Mel said they make me look cool!
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_013

english.description: I am Rashid of the Turbulent Wind! You can change how you feel, just with a title! If you had 30 of them, you'd be set for the rest of your life!
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_014

english.description: Alright, time you fought 10 network battles! The Internet is like my backyard - not a place I tend to lose! (Excludes Battle Lounge)
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_015

english.description: Master Zangief! I fought in 50 network battles! The ring came to life with the clash of burning spirits! (Excludes Battle Lounge)
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_016

english.description: Impossible! You fought in 300 network battles? Well then, the time for you to witness my Psycho Power draws near. Mwahaha! (Excludes Battle Lounge)
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_017

english.description: Patience is key to any warrior's training. Fight in network battles 30 times using the standby function. The longer you wait, the greater the joy will be when you finally get picked.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_018

english.description: Congratulations on your first win! Keep practicing your Kung Fu in those Ranked Matches and I know you'll only get better and better!
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_019

english.description: It seems you've won 10 Ranked Matches. Never forget how it feels to win, or your future will soon be eclipsed by defeat.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_020

english.description: 30 Ranked Matches already? Lemme go catch up to that! Dinner always tastes better after you've pummeled a bunch of chumps!
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_021

english.description: Ah, your 100th Ranked Match victory. That look in your eyes tells me it was a fulfilling battle. Go forward one step at a time, and never forget this feeling.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_022

english.description: Winning 300 matches will put the word out for Matsuda Jiu-Jitsu! It'll be like, "the succesor or Matsuda Jiu-Jitsu, Laura Matsuda is right here!"
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_023

english.description: Why not try fighting someone stronger than you in a Ranked Match? There's a lot you can gain from fighting stronger opponents. Beat 10 of 'em and you'll understand.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_024

english.description: Achieved three consecutive victories in Ranked Matches, have you? It appears you are getting a handle on your power. Maintain your modesty, and focus on your training; the path ahead is long.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_025

english.description: Master Zangief sent me flowers to celebrate me moving up a league for the first time! I can't read the card with all these tears!
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_026

english.description: Did you make it to Silver League?! Horosho! You have very good muscle! You can get much stronger from now!
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_027

english.description: Finally, Golden League! There are so many potential rivals! Now the fun really begins!
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_028

english.description: "Finishing with an EX Special Move sure feels good, old man!" "You finally understand then, young one? How about you try doing it 300 times?" "Wha?! You know how many years that'll take?!"
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_029

english.description: 300 Critical Art finishes... It would seem a crimson rose that blooms within an ugly heart can still be beautiful...
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_030

english.description: When you get that feeling like "I can't let it end like this!", that's when you should use a V-Reversal. Practice it 100 times, and then you'll be able to pull it off in your sleep!
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_031

english.description: There is a power that resides deep within you. If you wish to know what that power is, trigger a V-Skill 100 times. Do so, and that power will belong to you.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_032

english.description: You know, the V-Trigger is pretty handy for shifting the flow of battle. You'll know just how effective it is once you've triggered it 100 times.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_033

english.description: You must set a character as your favorite! Can't decide who to choose? Niiihehehe! Well, you can't go wrong with Lord Bison!
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_034

english.description: You'll never stand out without an original title. Try choosing an appropriate title for me.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_035

english.description: Collect 30 replays, kid. Once you've done your prep and know your opponent's weaknesses, you'll be in control of the fight. Don't risk your life by rushing in blind.
english.displayName: Failing To Prepare Is Preparing To Fail
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_036

english.description: Visualization is a crucial skill, so try watching 50 replays! I watched so many, I started seeing Master Zangief in my dreams!
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_037

english.description: When someone sets their sights on you, don't you just wanna try even harder? Add someone to your Favorites and see what happens!
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_038

english.description: I have the direct lines for all the world's leaders recorded in my pocketbook. You should have 30 names in your Favorites at the very least.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_039

english.description: Go try out Training Mode for 30 minutes! "Bodybuilding never let man down." I borrowed that one from Master Zangief!
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_040

english.description: It's about time you cleared Survival Mode on normal difficulty. You know what happens if you refuse, don't you? Let's just say the only way you live is if you keep on winning!
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_041

english.description: A warrior's soul is ri...ripened in Survival Mode. Emerge victorious on hard difficulty and you'll be ready for me to co...consume.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_042

english.description: Feel like taking the plunge into Survival Mode on extreme? Come back alive, and I'll grant you an audience with none other than me, the great Lord Bison!
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_043

english.description: You managed to get 1,000,000 FM. That's pretty good! The real value, however, is in the path you walked to earn that much.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_044

english.description: The true creme de la creme know how to give spectators a good show. Now go and gain new colors for your outfit.
english.displayName: The outfit is the highlight of battle
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_045

schinese.description: “厉害！你取得了所有的成就！真有两下子。你说是吧，Ryu？”“你穷尽了一条道路。成为真正战士的路还未结束，不过我们可以先庆祝你的成就。”
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_001

schinese.description: 为什么不试试看完教程呢？也许你已了解第一步，但是掌握基础才是最重要的。
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_002

schinese.description: 在故事模式中的第一个目标就是先破关一次。我当然先用 Zangief 大师！
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_003

schinese.description: 啊！这么多名人！好，逆卷风 Rashid，挑战 5 个角色故事！
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_004

schinese.description: 你想学习瑜伽？如果是这样，那你要先完成所有角色的角色故事。经历每个角色走过的路，是很有好处的。
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_005

schinese.description: 如果你不知道该怎么办，就把一名角色提升至等级 5。我想你就会知道自己缺乏什么了。
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_006

schinese.description: 你最好提升 5 个角色的等级。提升至等级 5 就可以了。食物与格斗都是要重数量而不是质量，兄弟。
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_007

schinese.description: 你的数量和力量一样逊，蠢材！把所有角色都提升至等级 5 再回来！
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_008

schinese.description: 你的目标应该是把一个角色提升至等级 30。难度很高但是很有意义的。为了找到答案，你必须把眼界放高一点。
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_009

schinese.description: 将你的等级提升至 50。等级提高，就可以向他报仇雪恨了。
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_010

schinese.description: 你的玩家等级就象征着你的激情！打破等级 100 的障碍！
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_011

schinese.description: 咦嘿嘿！2，20，200！多么美的数字！把你的玩家提升至等级 200 吧！这个位置是我的特等座位！
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_012

schinese.description: 收集 10 个称号如何？有称号是好事！因为 Mel 说那样我看起来会很酷！
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_013

schinese.description: 我是逆卷风 Rashid！只要一个称号，就能改变自己的感觉！如果你有 30 个称号，就一生都不用烦恼了！
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_014

schinese.description: 好，你已经打完 10 场联网格斗了！网络就像我的后院 - 我不会在自家后院输的！ （不包含战斗大厅）
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_015

schinese.description: “Zangief 大师！我打完 50 场联网格斗了！拳击擂台让我又燃起斗志了！” （不包含战斗大厅）
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_016

schinese.description: 你打完了 300 场联网格斗？哈哈哈，那你很快就可以见识到我的 Psycho Power 真正的力量了。（不包含战斗大厅）
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_017

schinese.description: 使用等待功能在联网格斗中战斗 30 次。等待时间越长，最后获得胜利时就越喜悦。
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_018

schinese.description: 你的首次胜利！恭喜！你在排名赛中越来越棒。我知道你会越来越好！
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_019

schinese.description: 你已经赢得了 10 场排名赛。不要忘了获胜的感觉，不然将来你只会被失败笼罩。
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_020

schinese.description: 等你赢得 30 场排名赛后再回来！打倒很多人之后的晚餐会更美味！
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_021

schinese.description: 这是你第 100 场排名赛胜利吗？你好像乐在其中呢。一次向前一步，永远不要忘了那种感觉。
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_022

schinese.description: 赢得 300 场比赛，每个人都会知道 Matsuda 流！到时候大家就会说：“Matsuda 流的继任者，Laura Matsuda 就在这里！”
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_023

schinese.description: 你试过在排名赛中和更强大的战士格斗吗？与强大对手格斗，你可以收获更多；等你打败其中 10 个就会明白了。
schinese.displayName: 我要去找比我更强的人
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_024

schinese.description: 3 连胜？看来你已经很会控制自己的力量了。保持谦虚，专注训练；前方的路还很长。
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_025

schinese.description: Zangief 大师送来鲜花祝贺我第一次在联赛升级！热泪盈眶让我都要看不清卡片上的字了！
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_026

schinese.description: 你达到白银联盟了吗？！Horosho！你很有天分！你可以变得比现在更强！
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_027

schinese.description: 终于来到金联盟！好多强敌呀！期待今后的战斗！
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_028

schinese.description: “使出 EX 必杀技 KO 对手感觉肯定很棒吧，老头！”“你终于明白了吗，少主？尝试 300 次怎么样？”“你疯了吗？那得要多少时间啊？”
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_029

schinese.description: 完成 300 次 Critical Art KO 吧…在丑人心中绽放的深红玫瑰也是很美的…。
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_030

schinese.description: 当你遇到那种“不能让它这样结束！”的状况时，V-Reversal 就有用了。练习 100 次。你就可以随意使出这一招了！
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_031

schinese.description: 你的体内藏着一股力量。如果你想知道那种力量是什么，使出 V-Skill 100 次，那种力量就属于你了。
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_032

schinese.description: 你知道，V-Trigger 可以扭转格斗的局势。使出 100 次，你就会知道它的威力。
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_033

schinese.description: 你必须设置一个自己爱用的角色！不能决定选谁？咦嘿嘿！选择 Bison 大人不会有错的！
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_034

schinese.description: 称号要自己决定才会发光。所以，为我选择你觉得最适合的名字吧。
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_035

schinese.description: 收集 30 次回放，孩子。准备好，知道对手的弱点，就可以万无一失地控制格斗了。不要盲目地拿自己的生命冒险。
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_036

schinese.description: 想像训练是门重要的技能！观看 50 次回放吧！我已经看了很多次，所以我连在梦里都能见到 Zangief 大师了！
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_037

schinese.description: 当有人把你视为目标之后，你不会想试试更困难的吗？添加某些人至你的收藏夹，看看会怎样！
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_038

schinese.description: 我的笔记本里记了所有世界领导人的联系方式。你的收藏夹里也应该有至少 30 个名字。
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_039

schinese.description: 在训练模式训练 30 分钟！“健身永远不会让人失望！”这是 Zangief 大师的一句话！
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_040

schinese.description: 时候后破解生存模式的普通程度了。你知道拒绝的话会怎样对吧？唯一能生存的方法就是不停地赢！
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_041

schinese.description: 战士的灵魂…在生存模式中磨炼成熟。在困难程度获胜后，就能让我…吞噬了。
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_042

schinese.description: 想要试试生存模式的地狱程度？只要你活着回来，我 Bison 就亲自当你的对手。
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_043

schinese.description: 你赢得了 1,000,000 FM。很棒！不过真正有价值的是你在这过程中得到的收获。
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_044

schinese.description: 一流的格斗家，当然也能让观众享受比赛。来吧，获取更多的颜色吧！
schinese.displayName: 好的服装能让战斗更有看头！
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_045
